title: Okta Management API token (SSWS): one-property twin (alphabet)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: a character outside the documented alphabet is present. Legacy mutation notes: alphabet: one "=" byte vs the trufflehog-corroborated [A-Za-z0-9_-] body (gitleaks's okta-access-token rule admits it). Twin of "Okta Management API token (SSWS): must be flagged (tool-corroborated) [legacy tier T2]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
